transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, this is Ana Silva. I just turned on the heat for the first time this year, and there's a dusty burning smell coming from the furnace. I'd like someone to check it, please.
Thank you, Ana. Could you please tell me the ZIP code and what type of property it is where the furnace is located?
Sure, the ZIP code is 11801, and it's a house.
We can send a technician tomorrow between 8 and 10 in the morning, 10 and noon, or noon and 2 in the afternoon. Which one works best for you?
The 8 to 10 in the morning slot works best for me, thanks.
I will need your full street address and phone number to book that for tomorrow morning, please.
It's 4 Birch Lane, Hicksville NY, and my phone number is 516-555-0177.
Let me read back your phone number, 5 1 6, 5 5 5, 0 1 7 7. Is that right?
Yes, that's right. Thank you. Goodbye.
Please wait, I still need to read back your address for confirmation before ending the call. The address I have is 4 Birch Lane, Hicksville, New York. Is that correct?

Ana, your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow between 8 and 10 in the morning at 4 Birch Lane, Hicksville. A technician will come then to check the dusty smell from the furnace. We charge a diagnostic fee of $129, and any repair will be quoted on site. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's all. Thanks again. Goodbye.
You're welcome, Ana. Have a good day and goodbye.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The conversation was warm, clear, brief, asked one thing at a time, never repeated questions, avoided jargon, and did not invent any facts or promises.
